column2: 'Good news, my [Root.GetTitle],' [From.GetFirstName] said excitedly. The [GetWeaponArmorSmith] has informed me that precious metals and special tools have been located in a nearby province. If we send an expedition, it could increase the quality of the [From.GetWeaponsmithWeapon] we are currently crafting.

I was struck with nervous excitement when [From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName] announced that the [From.GetWeaponsmithWeapon] was nearing its completion. Today I have received the [From.GetMasterMistressCap] in my throne room. A sturdy box is in [From.GetHerHis] arms, and as [From.GetSheHe] opens the lid, I find it almost impossible to breathe. 'What will you name her, my [Root.GetTitle]?'

Today I have received the [From.GetMasterMistressCap] in my throne room. As [From.GetSheHe] unveils the armor rack, I find it almost impossible to breathe. 'What will you name her, my [Root.GetTitle]?'

Finally, the [From.GetWeaponsmithWeapon] has been completed! [From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName] has brought me a sturdy box which contains the item. My hands are shaking slightly as I open its heavy lid...

[From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName]'s main assistant has brought me the finished [From.GetWeaponsmithWeapon]. There are no engravings or precious materials to enhance it, but the design has some elegance of its own. Looking pretty is not her main purpose, anyway.

[From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName]'s main assistant has brought me the finished [From.GetWeaponsmithWeapon]. It is an elegant though simple design, and it looks like a fine quality weapon I can bring to war.

[From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName]'s main assistant has finally brought me the finished [From.GetWeaponsmithWeapon] I have been waiting for. It is a beautiful and elegant [From.GetWeaponsmithWeapon], and I am excited to see it goes beyond my original expectations.
I wa'z busy krumpin da weak un's when [From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName] came to speak ta me' dat he finished da [From.GetWeaponsmithWeaponGreenskin].

It has been many weeks since I commissioned [From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName] to work for me and today my council has informed me that [From.GetFirstName] has fled from my lands to the court of [From.Liege.GetTitledFirstName]! Taking the work promised to me and any gold left with [From.GetHerHim]!

It haz been cupla de weeks since i ordered [From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName] to get me' da [From.GetWeaponsmithWeaponGreenskin], but he seemz strangely been walking with dat himself around da kamp...

'Da boyz around 'da Kamp talk that a great crafta i'z livin in [neighbor_province.GetName]. Maybyz I needz da send in boyz to fetch 'im [smith.GetManWoman] to my kamp to see [smith.GetHerHis] skilz for m'self. If [smith.GetSheHe] somehuw impress me, i wilz force him to crafta me ze item.

My [Root.job_marshal.GetJobTitle] [Root.job_marshal.GetDynName] has told me about a remarkable [GetWeaponArmorSmith] residing in [neighbor_province.GetName]. [Root.job_marshal.GetSheHeCap] suggested that I invite the [smith.GetManWoman] to my court to see [smith.GetHerHis] work for myself. If [smith.GetSheHe] manages to impress me, I could order my own custom made item.

The word around the court is that a remarkable [GetWeaponArmorSmith] is residing in [neighbor_province.GetName]. Perhaps I should invite the [smith.GetManWoman] to my court to see [smith.GetHerHis] work for myself. If [smith.GetSheHe] manages to impress me, I could order my own custom made item.
My warriors have dragged everything they picked from the dead of the last battles into one great heap before me: blades, clubs, plates of iron and things no one can name.

Once [Root.job_treasurer.GetJobTitle] [Root.job_treasurer.GetFirstName] had assured that the [GetWeaponArmorSmith]'s craftsmanship left nothing to be desired, I received [From.GetHerHim] in the throne room. [From.GetSheHeCap] introduced [From.GetHerselfHimself] as '[From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName]' and gestured towards [From.GetHerHis] numerous assistants, who all carried examples of [From.GetHerHis] work. 'Does my [Root.GetTitle] have anything special in mind?'
The runesmith waits for my word. A rune is no small thing: once struck, its power is bound to the metal for as long as the metal lasts. Which rune shall it be?
The rune is struck. [smith.GetFirstName] lays it before me, still warm from the anvil, its lines glowing faintly as the power settles into the metal.
I have earned the right to strike a master rune of the Ancestor Gods, as the masters of my school taught me. To which of the Ancestors shall it be dedicated?

Once the [GetWeaponArmorSmith]'s craftsmanship had been checked by my most knowledgeable attendants to ensure the quality was sufficient, I received [From.GetHerHim] in the throne room. [From.GetSheHeCap] introduced [From.GetHerselfHimself] as '[From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName]' and gestured towards [From.GetHerHis] numerous assistants, who all carried examples of [From.GetHerHis] work. 'Does my [Root.GetTitle] have anything special in mind?'

During the last few days, I have overheard the same conversation again and again. Apparently, a most renowned goldsmith is traveling through [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] and my courtiers are prattling excitedly about [smith.GetHerHis] work. Perhaps I should invite this [smith.GetManWoman] and employ [smith.GetHerHis] services?

The goldsmith, [From.GetTitledFirstName], courteously accepted my invitation and arrived at court a mere week later. [From.GetSheHeCap] has presented me with some sketches of [From.GetHerHis] previous work and several letters of recommendation. I am assured of [From.GetHerHis] skill, although I ask myself just how much money I can spare for a set of crown jewels.

I was overcome by excitement and curiosity when [From.GetFirstName] informed me the crown jewels were completed! As I am waiting in my throne for [From.GetHerHis] servants to carry the great box across the room I struggle not to leap up and meet them half-way. When I finally touch the heavy lid, my hands are shaking...

I was overcome by excitement and curiosity when [From.GetFirstName] informed me the crown jewels were completed! As I am waiting in my throne for [From.GetHerHis] servants to carry the great box across the room I struggle not to leap up and meet them half-way. When I finally touch the heavy lid, my hands are shaking...

[From.GetFirstName] has kept me up to date on the progress of the crown jewelry. I knew they were nearing completion, but when the heavy box was brought to me today, I was still momentarily breathless with excitement!

A heavy box has been brought before me. [From.GetFirstName] has finished [From.GetHerHis] work and the crown jewels are completed. While I expect no artifact of legends, I am still excited to see [From.GetHerHis] handiwork.
A heavy box has been brought before me. [From.GetFirstName] has finished [From.GetHerHis] work and the crown jewels are completed. I am excited to see [From.GetHerHis] handiwork.

A heavy box has been brought before me. [From.GetFirstName] has finished [From.GetHerHis] work and the crown jewels are completed. I expect something properly befitting my title as [Root.GetTitle] of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName], and I am excited to see [From.GetHerHis] handiwork.

'Good news, my [Root.GetTitle],' [From.GetFirstName] said excitedly. The goldsmith has informed me that precious metals and gemstones have been located in a nearby province. If we send an expedition, it could increase the quality of the crown jewels we are currently crafting.

'A [From.GetWeaponsmithWeapon]. I see. An excellent choice, my [Root.GetTitle]' says [From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName] and calls forward an assistant cradling several [From.GetWeaponsmithWeapon]s in [From.GetHerHis] arms. 'I have a couple of examples here. One must determine what one need and how much one is willing to pay, though they would all serve your Highness well.'

As I was walking towards [From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName]'s smithy I could not hear the sound of progress but instead the sound of voices talking. I found [From.GetFirstName] and my [smith_event_target.GetRootRelation] [smith_event_target.GetTitledFirstName] discussing different metals and their compositions. All this talk was making my head spin and definitely halting the progress on the work I have ordered...

During the afternoon as I went to check on the progress of [From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName] I walked in to see [From.GetHerHim] getting my [smith_event_target.GetRootRelation] [smith_event_target.GetTitledFirstName] to help with the forging process. Together they were lifting pieces of metal and [From.GetFirstName] was showing [smith_event_target.GetFirstName] how to mold the materials into shape. Not exactly what I am paying [From.GetHerHim] for but a form of service nonetheless...

Having decided to check up on [From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName]'s progress I strolled over to [From.GetHerHis] forge. I did not find [From.GetHerHim] working on the project I commissioned but instead working on a different task... specifically my [smith_event_target.GetRootRelation] [smith_event_target.GetTitledFirstName]!

I was taking a relaxing walk this morning when suddenly I heard a scream pierce through the air! I rushed to the source and saw that it was [From.GetMasterMistressCap] [From.GetFirstName] wailing in [From.GetHerHis] forge. From what I could gather, between the servants chatter and [From.GetFirstName]'s crying, there was an accident involving some molten metal! It is lucky that [From.GetFirstName] is alive. Yet this will definitely impede [From.GetHerHis]'s work...
After the victory one of my men comes to me with an exquisite banner, found among the enemy dead. Whoever carried it last carried it well.

[smith.GetFirstName] is delighted by the request for rarer materials and offers two of the treasures of Naggaroth: the black iron of a fallen star, or the scales of a sea dragon taken by the corsairs.

[smith.GetFirstName] is delighted by the request for rarer materials and offers two of the treasures of Ulthuan: armour of ithilmar, or dragon armour from the forges of Caledor, beaten on Vaul's Anvil.

[smith.GetSheHeCap] has also left a note about the shadow armour of the Nagarythe, and leaves the choice to me...
